name: terminal-dogma
author: Andreas Varotsis
description: Evangelion/NERV-inspired Pebble Time 2 watchface: MAGI-style HUD with honest health, battery, phone-link and weather states (Pebble weather plugin source with Open-Meteo fallback), configurable modules, accent colour, Celsius/Fahrenheit weather, a configurable SYNC rail, optional MAGI/system-boot transitions (Off/Subtle/Full), and a shake-to-show heart-rate graph with reversible timed transitions by default, with an optional forecast.

usesPermissions.name: Location
usesPermissions.reason: To show the weather where you are

usesPermissions.name: Internet
usesPermissions.reason: To fetch weather from Open-Meteo when no Pebble weather source is available
